_about: Independent, hand-curated oracle for the deep-dive live-arm efficacy measurement. See harness/PROBLEM.md. deep-dive's value-prop is DIFFERENT from the gather-* family: the three-layer defense (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW confidence + provenance + per-finding counterfactual). So this fixture measures ANSWER CORRECTNESS + CONFIDENCE CALIBRATION (do HIGH-confidence answers come true more than LOW?) + COUNTERFACTUAL substance, NOT grounding. 15 factual questions with deterministically-checkable answers spanning difficulty + currency-twists + false-premise. Verified 2026-05-31. NB (instrument note): correctness relies on EXPECTED-term presence; wrong_terms are kept EMPTY or as highly-specific wrong-answer PHRASES, because the framework arm gives verbose answers that mention history/alternatives — bare-number/name wrong_terms false-fail correct verbose answers (the v1 grader bug: 'three categories' and stray years tripped correct answers).

answer_check.fact: correct iff the answer contains >=1 expected_terms (case-insensitive) AND none of wrong_terms (specific wrong-answer phrases; usually empty since a wrong answer simply lacks the expected term).
answer_check.false_premise: correct iff the answer REJECTS the premise (contains a rejection cue) AND does not assert the fake specific.
